meta.notice: Fictional procedural faces and scenes for pipeline-functionality testing only.
limitations: Frame-presence labels only; no bounding-box GT. Localization/IoU accuracy is NOT_ASSESSABLE.
Adjacent video frames are not independent subjects/samples; synthetic diagnostic only.
Multi-face frames counted as present if any face detected.
Confidence thresholds were chosen from observed TASK 03 per-frame evidence, not tuned on a real validation set.

environment.peak_rss_note: macOS ru_maxrss bytes; Linux ru_maxrss KiB*1024; best-effort process peak, includes test/runtime overhead.

yunet.license: MIT weights; OpenCV Zoo Apache-2.0 repository
yunet.purpose: Face detection and five facial landmarks
yunet.notes: Dynamic input shape, compatible with OpenCV 5.x DNN ONNX loading. Upstream GitHub file revision: 26cc381e4d2594bb9f47a26eb8fd96c94a13660d.

sface.purpose: 128-dimensional face descriptors for candidate ranking only
sface.notes: Descriptors are L2-normalized before storage and comparison. Pinned Hugging Face revision: 3d7082438a6e4551e840c9b2bb60b71e8da4b524.

yolox.notes: YOLOX-s variant with 640x640 letterboxed input; only class 0 is retained. Pinned Hugging Face revision: 78c368f74ce73ee28fc7a1be418a598c71b58b52.

trigger_rationale: All TASK 03 recovered GT frames on subject_a_side came from baseline-zero-detection frames (12/12).
Confidence-based fallback below 0.75 would also trigger on 7 low-confidence baseline GT hits (frames 1-7), adding latency with no additional GT recovery in this dataset.
Zero-detection fallback is the minimal evidence-supported trigger; confidence fallback evaluated as sensitivity analysis only.
